column1: # Candidates for the detection table. Numbers are pulled from result files by scripts/16_detection_table.py;
# this file only says WHERE to find them and supplies the (hypothesis-level) competing explanations/limitations.
# source: main = step 6 full panel (all trimmed pairs); nonhost = step 6 PANEL=nonhost (non-host pool);
#         human = step 14; kmer = step 15; chimera = step 7 contigs
# label: genome used for gene-level support (step 9); coverage columns always refer to the step-6 Stage B reference named in 'reference'.
# names_*: ';'-separated taxon names (genus-level for genus-level groups) used to look up STAT (tax_table 'org', total_count), Bracken species/genus
#          (non-host pool, name column) and SendSketch (Ref column, best WKID) evidence.
